career_ladder.note: RRB Technician recruits skilled technical personnel across mechanical, electrical, civil, and signal & telecommunication workshops and open-line maintenance depots under Indian Railways. Technicians advance through time-scale grade promotions and internal departmental competitive examinations (LDCE) up to supervisory and Group 'B' Gazetted officer ranks.

exam_scheme.note: Under RRB CEN 02/2024, recruitment is conducted through post-specific single-stage Computer Based Tests (CBTs): a dedicated technical CBT for Technician Grade I Signal (Level 5) and a trade-relevant CBT for Technician Grade III (Level 2). Each test comprises 100 multiple-choice questions for 100 marks over 90 minutes. Penalty of 1/3 (0.33) marks applies for every incorrect answer. Shortlisted candidates proceed to Document Verification (DV) and Medical Examination in Railway Hospitals.

financial_package.pay_source_label: Railway Recruitment Boards — CEN No. 02/2024, Pay Scale for Technician Grade III (Level 2)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated at Level 2 entry basic pay (₹19,900) for Technician Grade III with 58% DA (₹11,542), HRA (9%/18%/27%), and Transport Allowance. For Technician Grade I Signal (Pay Level 5, entry basic ₹29,200), initial gross salary ranges from ₹51,000 to ₹64,000 with in-hand pay between ₹44,000 and ₹56,000. Workshop staff also receive workshop incentive bonus allowances.
official_perks: All-India free Railway Privilege Passes and Privilege Ticket Orders (PTOs) for self and family
Free medical care in dedicated Indian Railway Hospitals and Health Units
Railway residential quarters or House Rent Allowance (9%/18%/27% as per city classification)
Night Duty Allowance (NDA) and National Holiday Allowance (NHA) for operational shifts
Monthly workshop incentive bonus / production bonus in manufacturing and repair workshops
Contributory social security under National Pension System (NPS)

competition_benchmarks.note: RRB Technician is one of the most widely taken industrial technical recruitments in India. CEN 02/2024 originally advertised 9,144 vacancies across 21 Railway Recruitment Boards, later enhanced to 14,298 vacancies across 40 specialized trades. In the previous combined CEN 01/2018 recruitment drive, over 47 lakh candidates competed for ALP and Technician posts.
